dimensions.assessment: Applies to state and local government agencies across the United States that receive federal law enforcement grant funding.
dimensions.evidence: prohibit the award of Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grants to States or units of local government that limit the use of cash bail

dimensions.assessment: Stops federal grant funding for jurisdictions that enact cashless bail laws or policies covering specific violent or public-disorder offenses.
dimensions.evidence: the Attorney General may not award, renew, or extend a grant under this subpart to a State or unit of local government

dimensions.assessment: Reallocates or restricts federal grant distributions under the Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant Program for non-compliant state and local governments.
dimensions.evidence: prohibit the award of Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grants

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Omnibus Crime Control and Safe Streets Act of 1968 to add grant eligibility restrictions based on state and local bail policies.
dimensions.evidence: amend the Omnibus Crime Control and Safe Streets Act of 1968 to prohibit the award of Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grants

dimensions.assessment: Permanent restriction on grant awards effective for the fiscal year following enactment and each fiscal year thereafter.
dimensions.evidence: for the fiscal year beginning on the first October 1 occurring after the date of enactment... and each fiscal year thereafter

importance_detail.rationale: The bill blocks Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grants to state or local governments that implement policies limiting cash bail for certain covered offenses.
